程序包 org.bukkit.command

类 Command

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.command.Command
直接已知子类:
BukkitCommand, FormattedCommandAlias, MultipleCommandAlias, PluginCommand, VanillaCommand
public abstract class Command extends Object
Represents a Command, which executes various tasks upon user input 表示一个命令，它在用户输入时执行各种任务

      public abstract boolean execute(CommandSender sender, String commandLabel, String[] args)
      Executes the command, returning its success 执行该命令，返回其执行结果
      参数:
      sender - Source object which is executing this command 正在执行此命令的来源对象
      commandLabel - The alias of the command used 所使用的命令别名
      args - All arguments passed to the command, split via ' ' 传递给该命令的所有参数，以 ' ' 分割
      返回:
      true if the command was successful, otherwise false 若命令成功则为 true，否则为 false

    • tabComplete

      public List<String> tabComplete(CommandSender sender, String alias, String[] args, Location location) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Executed on tab completion for this command, returning a list of options the player can tab through. This method returns the Location of the block the player is looking at at the time of the tab complete. 在此命令进行 Tab 补全时执行，返回玩家可以 Tab 浏览的选项列表。此方法返回玩家在 Tab 补全时所注视方块的 Location。

      Commands that want to use the Location information in their tab-complete implementations need to override this method. The Location provided by this method is the block that the player is currently looking at when the player attempts the tab complete. For this to be valid, the block must be highlighted by the player (i.e. the player is close enough to interact with the block). 想要在其 Tab 补全实现中使用 Location 信息的命令需要重写此方法。此方法提供的 Location 是玩家尝试 Tab 补全时正注视的方块。要使其有效，该方块必须被玩家选中（即玩家距离足够近以与该方块交互）。

      参数:
      sender - Source object which is executing this command 正在执行此命令的来源对象
      alias - the alias being used 正在使用的别名
      args - All arguments passed to the command, split via ' ' 传递给该命令的所有参数，以 ' ' 分割
      location - the location of the block the player is looking at 玩家所注视方块的位置
      返回:
      a list of tab-completions for the specified arguments. This 指定参数的 Tab 补全列表。这永远不会为 null。列表可能是不可变的。 will never be null. List may be immutable.
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if sender, alias, or args is null 若 sender、alias 或 args 为 null

    • setName

      public boolean setName(String name)
      Sets the name of this command. 设置此命令的名称。

      May only be used before registering the command. Will return true if the new name is set, and false if the command has already been registered. 只能在注册命令之前使用。若新名称已设置则返回 true；若命令已被注册则返回 false。

      参数:
      name - New command name 新命令名称
      返回:
      returns true if the name change happened instantly or false if 若名称立即更改则为 true，若命令已被注册则为 false the command was already registered

    • testPermission

      public boolean testPermission(CommandSender target)
      Tests the given CommandSender to see if they can perform this command. 测试给定的 CommandSender 以查看其能否执行此命令。

      If they do not have permission, they will be informed that they cannot do this. 若其没有权限，将被告知无法执行此操作。

      参数:
      target - User to test 要测试的用户
      返回:
      true if they can use it, otherwise false 若其可以使用则为 true，否则为 false

    • testPermissionSilent

      public boolean testPermissionSilent(CommandSender target)
      Tests the given CommandSender to see if they can perform this command. 测试给定的 CommandSender 以查看其能否执行此命令。

      No error is sent to the sender. 不会向发送者发送错误消息。

      参数:
      target - User to test 要测试的用户
      返回:
      true if they can use it, otherwise false 若其可以使用则为 true，否则为 false
